_about:
How far away is the value? Duration and distant cash-flow checks for each modelled stock -> data/duration.json.
Information only: nothing here changes a fair value, a rating or a margin of safety.

mos_rule.review: after the Q4 2026 earnings round (about February 2027)

concerns.beyond10: More than 60% of the base value arrives after year 10
concerns.end10: Fair value falls more than 15% if the edge ends at year 10
concerns.score: The moat scorecard suggests a lower class than the model uses
concerns.fade: Returns above the hurdle are halving in under 5 years
concerns.price: Today's price needs a longer advantage period than ours
